verdict.rationale: Adyen In-Person Payments is a SaaS that processes merchant and shopper transaction data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The axis therefore applies. Nothing in the pack covers an AI-training opt-out, data-use restrictions, or a training-related privacy policy. The MCP server and shopper-recognition items cover other capabilities and do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
